ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: In $\triangle ABC$, $\angle BAC=50^\circ$, $\angle B=48^\circ$, $AD$ is the angle bisector of $\triangle ABC$. What is the measure of $\angle ADC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $\angle BAC=50^\circ$ and $\angle B=48^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle C=180^\circ-\angle BAC-\angle B=82^\circ$, \\
since $AD$ is the bisector of $\triangle ABC$, \\
it implies that $\angle CAD=\frac{1}{2}\angle BAC=25^\circ$, \\
hence, $\angle ADC=180^\circ-\angle CAD-\angle C=\boxed{73^\circ}$.
